features: duration, leading silence, trailing silence, internal silence, speech ratio, number of speech segments; time features log1p-transformed; nothing spectral
training: dev only, 10000 bona fide + 10000 spoof, seed 258
test: eval: 5000 uncoded bona fide; 1000 uncoded spoofs per attack; 1000 bona fide + 1000 spoof per codec
score: log-odds of bona fide (higher = more likely real), same convention as cm-score
expectation: EER near 50% on every slice; a slice well below that means trivial cues separate the classes there, which is reported as a finding
